notes: Read SKILL.md in full (single-file skill). Read-only (allowed-tools: Read, Grep, Glob) network segmentation review: zone mapping, trust-boundary/PEP evaluation, VLAN design, east-west controls and micro-segmentation readiness, DMZ and PCI CDE segmentation, mapped to NIST SP 800-207 and CIS Controls v8 Control 12.

No commands, installs, credentials, or network access. Step 6 (SKILL.md:236-245) describes a segmentation-testing methodology (reachability and VLAN-hopping tests) that the agent is asked to 'document or verify the existence of'; it does not instruct the agent to probe networks itself, and such testing is for the user's own environment.
